Parking Regulations (night parking, alternate side, winter)

_meta.format: b[] = {c: City centerline OBJECTID, s: street, l: cross streets, h: neighborhood, n: [lowest, highest house number], o: the side with odd numbers (L|R), g: centerline [[lng,lat]], d: [[side L|R, compass label, rules]]}; rule = [-1, 2, 6, 0, 0, 6, list] for alternate side night parking, or [-1, 2, 6, 0, 0, 14, "ban"] for the winter ban on both sides (no parking 2 to 6 AM on the mornings of that list in `dates`; the list is named for the side cars park on that night, from the date of the evening before, so the odd side carries "even"), or [-1, 2, 6, 0, 0, 2, "all"] for the winter night ban on through highways and bus routes (both sides); flags 2 = towable, 4 = a side-switching rule shown as tonight's side (data/milwaukee/winter.json), 8 = both sides closed; lists are named for the side cars park on that night: odd/even all year, wodd/weven winter only, sodd/seven all year but winter, ban the winter mornings (none on Sundays or holiday mornings)
